# Demo profile portraits

Generated with the built-in image-generation tool on 12 November 2026. These are fictional adults for prototype fixtures, not actual members. Original generated PNGs are preserved here. Users can replace or remove these through the existing profile editor.

## alex-v1.png

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: square profile photograph for a fictional clinic demo roster. Make a single candid-looking iPad front-camera check-in portrait, head and shoulders. Face centered enough for a circular avatar crop; entire head visible. Ordinary indoor daylight mixed with overhead room light, slight front-camera wide-angle perspective, natural skin texture and small imperfections, mundane off-white clinic room background still in focus. Casual everyday photo someone quickly took at check-in, not a professional portrait, no studio light, no bokeh, no retouching, no glamour, no text, no logos, no device or hands in view. Entirely invented adult, no resemblance to any public figure. A person around 38 with light skin, short slightly tousled brown hair and light stubble, charcoal crewneck T-shirt, small closed-mouth smile, slightly low camera angle.
